title: Subscribe
description: Open a stream. The device clamps `rate_hz` to what it supports and returns the actual rate. Subscribing again to the same topic replaces the earlier subscription.

rate_hz.description: Requested rate. Ignored for event-driven topics such as `log`.

fields.description: Only send these payload fields. Omit for all.

max_px.description: `camera` only: longest side of a frame in pixels (default 320).
